purpose: This table is the cleaned, duplicate-checked record of OurAirports airports that carry an IATA code, one row per airport, feeding downstream airport reference, geocoding, and routing analytics.
usage: Join on airport_id (or ident_code/iata_code) for airport lookups; treat the continent value NA and country_code value NA as North America and Namibia respectively, not missing data; filter or coalesce nullable columns (elevation_feet, municipality, icao_code, gps_code, local_code, home_link, wikipedia_link, keywords) before aggregation since they are retained with nulls rather than imputed.
limitations: Highly sparse columns (local_code null_rate 0.636635, home_link null_rate 0.749034, keywords null_rate 0.679585) remain largely empty and were not backfilled; elevation_feet (null_rate 0.036988) and icao_code (null_rate 0.136579) retain nulls where the publisher did not supply a value; duplicate_row_rate was 0.0 so no dedupe logic was needed.
